skipped_by_rule.here: flips: handing something over vs stating location
skipped_by_rule.stop: citable translations are infinitives — wrong register for a shouted command; per-language imperatives need hand curation
skipped_by_rule.excuse_me: only citable sense is the farewell; recognition variants merged into 'sorry' (judgement call)
skipped_by_rule.again: no translation table for the 'once more' sense — the near-miss tables would miscite
skipped_by_rule.good_night: no direct table — wiktionary only cross-references ('see you tomorrow'); candidate for a signed-off hand-curated exception
skipped_by_rule.youre_welcome: reply-sense filed under 'of course'/'no problem'; recognition folded into no_problem (function-equivalent reply, judgement call)
skipped_by_rule.youre_right: only a cross-reference to verb 'be right' — wrong register
skipped_by_rule.how: interrogative sense has no translation table on wiktionary (only the 'How!' greeting is tabled) — wrong-sense data forbidden by the citation rule
